subject: Proposal: invoice automation webhook + email fallback for AP ingestion
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmeap.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Proposal: invoice automation webhook + email fallback for AP ingestion

Hi Elena,

Quick note on a proposed flow to streamline invoice ingestion on both sides. We can push invoice payloads from Redwood to Acme's AP using a webhook or SFTP drop. For safety and auditability we suggest:  

- Primary: webhook POST to your ingestion endpoint (JSON or XML) with an immediate 2xx acknowledgement expected.
- Secondary: SFTP drop of the generated PDF/XML (fallback when webhook returns non-2xx).
- Email copy: send a PDF copy to your AP mailbox as a fallback/notification for manual processes (ap@acmeap.com).

Validation logic we plan to include in the payload: VAT ID in header, PO number mapping (field: original_po_number), total tax lines with separate VAT breakdown, and a signature hash for integrity checks. If payload validation fails, the runtime will perform 2 retries (30s apart) then trigger our manual-review queue.

Attachments: invoice_sample.xml (XML schema we will send), vat_certificate_sample.pdf (sample evidence).

Questions for you before we run a pilot:
1) Which endpoint should we target for webhook delivery? (URL + any HMAC header expectations)
2) Do you want an email copy to always be sent to ap@acmeap.com during the pilot, or only on webhook failure?
3) For VAT evidence, do you want the certificate to be attached on every invoice PDF, or sent once per entity and referenced on invoices?

We'd like to run a small pilot week of Apr 27–30 to validate the flow and PO matching against your AP system. If that works, we can roll to live with a 2-week monitoring window.

Thanks — CC'ing Kimberly to confirm manual fallback and SLA details.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachments: invoice_sample.xml (xml), vat_certificate_sample.pdf (pdf)
From: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmeap.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: invoice automation webhook + email fallback for AP ingestion

Hi Ben — thanks for the clear proposal. A few clarifications from AP:  

- Preference: we prefer SFTP ingestion for the file drop as the primary channel for most vendors. We can accept a webhook but it would be processed into the same queue. During the pilot we can accept webhook + SFTP in parallel if Redwood wants to validate both.
- Email copy: please always send a PDF copy to ap@acmeap.com during the pilot. Our team will use the email as a reconciliation artifact.
- VAT evidence: we require the VAT ID on the invoice PDF (header) and a copy of the VAT certificate once per legal entity. If you include a VAT reference field on every invoice (vat_evidence_ref: <doc-id>), that will be helpful.

PO matching: critical for our AP — please ensure the original_po_number field maps to our PO system. If the webhook/SFTP payload contains both original_po_number and vendor_account_code we should be able to auto-match.

Failure handling: if automated ingestion fails, our expectation is that Redwood pushes an email copy within 5 minutes of failure so we can triage quickly. Is that achievable?

Elena Martinez
AP Manager, Acme Healthcare
elena.martinez@acmeap.com
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmeap.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: invoice automation webhook + email fallback for AP ingestion

Thanks Elena — appreciate the clear preferences. Confirming Redwood's proposed fallback and SLA details for the pilot:  

- Primary ingestion: SFTP (preferred) / webhook accepted.
- On webhook/SFTP validation failure: Redwood runtime will perform 2 automated retries (30s/60s). If still failing, an automated email (PDF) will be sent to ap@acmeap.com within 5 minutes of the final retry attempt.
- Manual review: Failures that do not auto-resolve will generate a ticket assigned to our Billing Ops team. SLA: initial human review within 8 business hours, resolution/patch or manual delivery within 24 business hours.
- VAT evidence handling: We will attach the VAT certificate on first invoice for a given legal entity and include a vat_evidence_ref field on subsequent invoices. For the pilot we will also attach the certificate to each PDF copy to avoid confusion.

Escalation path (short):
1) Billing Ops (billing-ops@redwood.ai) — 8h human review
2) Ops escalation: connor.obrien@redwood.ai (if manual remedy needed beyond 24h)
I've uploaded our fallback runbook and test payloads to the shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcTestInvoiceSamples and created a Jira ticket to track the pilot: JIRA-INV-8421. Also added a DocuSign envelope for the standard SLAs: https://app.docusign.com/prepare/Envelope12345

Attachment: fallback_runbook.pdf (contains retry logic, triage steps, and sample email templates).

If this looks good we'll target Apr 27 for a 48–72 hour test window with 5–10 sample invoices. Ben — can you confirm the billing contacts and whether Acme will provide SFTP credentials or a test endpoint?

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Director, Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Martinez <elena.martinez@acmeap.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposal: invoice automation webhook + email fallback for AP ingestion

Elena — thanks. Confirming pilot target: 2026-04-27.

Requests before we start:  
- Please confirm the AP billing contact (name + email) that will receive the test copies.
- Share SFTP credentials or a test endpoint URL and any HMAC header shared secret for webhooks.
- Sample PO number format if there are quirks we should be aware of (prefixes, leading zeros).

We'll stage 5 invoices the first day and monitor matching rates, then adjust payload fields as needed. If everything looks good we'll extend the window.

Best,
Ben
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
